text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- About 400 Arab urologists attended the first Arab congress of urology held in the resort of Sousse.
- Culture Minister Abdelbaki Hermassi stressed Tunisian efforts to protect human rights. LE TEMPS
- Good results in tourism in the southeastern region during the first five months of 1997.
- Tunisia and Senegal signed an accord to develop partnership in veterinary medicine.
